title: Pressed Flowers: Coloring Book for Adults and Teens, Bold and Easy
subtitle: 50 Vintage Botanical Designs Featuring Dried Flowers, Herbarium Pages, and Delicate Floral Arrangements for Relaxation
description:
Discover the delicate beauty of pressed flowers and vintage botanical art in every page.


Inspired by the timeless art of flower pressing and antique herbarium collections, this coloring book features graceful arrangements of dried flowers, fern fronds, and botanical specimens. Each illustration captures the elegant simplicity of vintage pressed flower art with bold, easy-to-color outlines. From single stems to elaborate floral compositions, every page is a gentle invitation to slow down and create something beautiful.

What's Inside:
• 50 unique pressed flower and vintage botanical illustrations
• Dried roses, daisies, ferns, wildflowers, and delicate petal arrangements
• Herbarium-style layouts, floral frames, and botanical specimen pages
• Single-sided pages to prevent bleed-through
• Large 8.5 x 8.5 inch pages for comfortable coloring
• Bold outlines perfect for colored pencils, markers, and gel pens

Perfect For:
• Relaxation and mindful creative time
• A thoughtful gift for flower lovers and vintage art fans
• Botanical art inspiration and quiet afternoon coloring
• All skill levels — beginners to experienced colorists

Pick up your colors and bring these timeless botanicals to life.
Each page is a small garden of calm waiting for your touch.
